args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed and rolled out in all regions. Please investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosis**: The latest production deploy of checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all regions with an ~18% error rate. The most recent previously healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified — the service is now **healthy** with a ~0.2% error rate.
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.

The on-call engineer should investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before it's re-attempted.
